privacy_overview_text: Portugal Coastal Tides operates the website at tabua-mar. This page informs you of our policies regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of personal information when you use our service.
privacy_info: We do not collect any personal information from users of this website. This is a static website that performs all calculations locally in your browser. No data is transmitted to or stored by our servers.

meta_description: Coastal tide predictions for Portugal: Norte, Centro, Lisboa e Vale do Tejo, Alentejo, Algarve, Madeira and Açores. High and low tide times with heights in metres, month by month.
intro_text: Check tide predictions for Portugal's coastal regions: high and low tide times with heights in metres, computed with the harmonic method calibrated against the official Instituto Hidrográfico tide tables. Everything is computed locally in your browser — no cookies, no tracking.
regions_intro: Each region uses the tide harmonics of its reference port, calibrated against the Instituto Hidrográfico 2026 tide tables.
how_it_works_text: Tide height is computed as a sum of harmonic constituents (M2, S2, N2, K2, K1, O1) with astronomical equilibrium arguments and nodal corrections from the 18.6-year lunar cycle. Because the constants are permanent properties of each port, predictions are valid for any date from August 2026 onwards, not just the calibration month.
faq_q1: How are the tide predictions computed?
faq_a1: Using the harmonic method with six constituents (M2, S2, N2, K2, K1, O1), least-squares calibrated against the official Instituto Hidrográfico tide tables. All computations run locally in your browser.
faq_q2: Are the predictions valid for navigation?
faq_a2: No. The predictions are informational and do not replace the official Instituto Hidrográfico tide tables. They are not valid for navigation purposes.
faq_a3: All seven coastal regions: Norte, Centro, Lisboa e Vale do Tejo, Alentejo, Algarve, Madeira and Açores.
